Answer: B
Reason: The serial chest X-rays (Figures 1a, 3a, 4a, 6a) demonstrate a clear progression from initial nodular densities predominantly in the middle and lower lung fields to extensive, diffuse bilateral infiltrative involvement with areas of radiolucency over time. This pattern matches the description of progressive spread and consolidation typical for advanced bronchioloalveolar carcinoma (now invasive mucinous adenocarcinoma).
